description: Telecommunication Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka - Regulation for Satellite Broadband Service under Sri Lanka Telecommunications Act No. 25 of 1991
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Technology under the Sri Lanka Telecommunications Act, establishing licensing fees for Satellite Broadband Service. This constitutes legal/regulatory framework creation and falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it involves regulatory matters and compliance requirements for telecommunications services.
